swiss._comment: TCEC Swiss is Fork's PRIMARY target event (S30: AI-assisted engines enter only via the Swiss). Values are for Swiss 10 (S30). See docs/kb/competition.md, section 'TCEC Swiss (primary target)'.

format.double_rounds_note: Swiss 10 page: 13 double rounds; schedule.json: 624 games = 13 x 24 pairs x 2. The generic TCEC_Swiss_rules page says 11 (changed from 12 on 21 Nov 2025); the event page governs.
format.game_pair_note: each pairing plays two games with the same opening and colours reversed, back to back in schedule.json
format.pairing_system: TCEC Swiss Tournament System (deterministic, Monrad-like). Pairing order = score desc, then seed asc. The top unpaired engine meets the highest-ranked engine it has not met, subject to colour balance and to a full pairing still being possible (Blossom check); if none exists, the oldest rounds are dropped from the encounter history.
format.colours: double rounds: first-of-pair (higher in pairing order) has Black in game 1 and White in game 2
format.seeding: group seeding by strength: Swiss 10 used 10 groups (A-J), seed order A1,B1,...,J1,A2,...; round 1 pairs A1-B1, C1-D1, ...; previous Swiss winner is A1
format.rating_input: only through seeding: last Leagues standings and/or Elo after testing (TCEC bayeselo list, Elo snapshot), at the organisers' discretion. From round 2 pairings use score and seed only.
format.byes: odd field only: one bye per round, scored as a win, given to the lowest-ranked engine with the fewest byes

time_control.time_loss: counts as a loss, not replayed
time_control.margin_note: UNVERIFIED meaning: Swiss 10 page notes a one-second margin in the actual event (written next to a time-loss report)

openings.source: random book exit per pairing from a book by the TCEC book team (Swiss 10 book assembled by Bastiaan, kbg519v1a)

tiebreaks.decisive_places: winner, promotions and any placement affecting later events: points only; ties resolved by extra game pairs (2 engines, until one pair is decisive) or extra DRRs (3+ engines)
tiebreaks.note: TD amendment of 22 Dec 2025 extended the points-only rule to the winner

swiss.adjudication: same as top-level 'adjudication' (Swiss rules sections 6-7 carry the identical draw rule and outage rules)

hardware_and_settings.move_overhead: engine default unless the author asks (Reckless runs MoveOverhead=1000 in Swiss 10)
hardware_and_settings.note: same machines and caps as top-level 'hardware'; values read from live.json engine options on 2026-10-23

swiss.updates: testing is run for all invited engines before the Swiss; no updates or fixes once the Swiss has started; a crash is a loss

entry.invitation: organisers invite; questionnaire mandatory; Swiss 10 submission deadline was 1 Jul 2026 12:00 UTC

categories.0: placed automatically (engines with a Leagues place not relegated from the lowest league; organisers' discretion); 32 in Swiss 10
categories.1: additional and new engines: playoff 1 DRR at 30+3 for 10 spots (the lighter group, meant for HCE engines per the Potential decision)
categories.3: joint Cat 3+4 playoff, 12 DRR at 30+3, for 1 Swiss spot
categories.4: engines made with major AI help: one place in the Cat 3+4 playoff; code public and open source during participation; TCEC admins build the binary

entry.categorisation_appeal: 24 h after TCEC announces final categories; TD decision final; no mid-season architecture change into a higher category
entry.cat4_route_s30: Cat 4 -> Cat 3+4 playoff (12 DRR at 30+3) -> 1 Swiss spot -> Swiss. Not eligible for the Leagues however it scores; a separate 'extra gauntlet' is promised (format UNVERIFIED).
entry.cat4_preplayoff_if_several: UNVERIFIED: the page does not say how several Cat 4 engines would compete for the single playoff place
entry.s30_cat34_result: 3 engines, 72 games, 9-12 Sep 2026: Cinder 31.5/48 (qualified), CatGPT (Cat 4) 27/48, Serendipity 13.5/48
entry.promotion_from_swiss_10: top 32 -> Cup 17; the 17 engines without a Leagues place compete for 7 Entrance League spots (top 5 direct, middle 10 tiebreak for 2, bottom 2 out). Not open to Cat 4 in S30.

draw.from_move_note: no minimum move number in the current rule
draw.both_engines_note: UNVERIFIED: rule refers to the eval of the move leading to the position

game_end.win_rule_history: The +/-10.00 for 10 plies 'TCEC win rule' is in the S17-S19 rules; TCEC_Season_20_Rules states it is dropped from S20 onward; no later rule page restores it.
game_end.resignation_trigger: UNVERIFIED: the rules do not say how resignation happens; all 212 decisive Swiss 10 games so far are recorded as ending in mate

tablebase.note: TB adjudication (6-man Syzygy via cutechess) was removed from the Leagues rules between the revisions of 13 Oct 2024 and 4 May 2025 and is absent from the current Swiss, Leagues and Rules pages. Swiss 10: 129 of 212 decisive games ended in mate with 6 or fewer men on the board. Engines still get 7-man Syzygy for their own probing.

outage_only._note: Applies ONLY when the game server is interrupted (disconnect, lag time loss, other non-engine interruption). This is NOT adjudication during normal play.
outage_only.win_note: Swiss/Leagues numbered rules say both evals at least |10|; the prose copies on the Rules page say more than +10 / less than -10
outage_only.otherwise: restart from the reached position with time compensation

entry.ai_assisted_requirements: public open-source repo for the whole participation; TCEC admins build the binary from it
